results.text: Mr. Quilter is the apostle of the middle classes, and we are glad to welcome his gospel.
results.ref_text: MISTER QUILTER IS THE APOSTLE OF THE MIDDLE CLASSES AND WE ARE GLAD TO WELCOME HIS GOSPEL

results.text: Nor is Mister Quilter's manner less interesting than his matter.
results.ref_text: NOR IS MISTER QUILTER'S MANNER LESS INTERESTING THAN HIS MATTER

results.text: He tells us that at this festive season of the year, with Christmas and roast beef looming before us, similes drawn from eating and its results occur most readily to the mind.
results.ref_text: HE TELLS US THAT AT THIS FESTIVE SEASON OF THE YEAR WITH CHRISTMAS AND ROAST BEEF LOOMING BEFORE US SIMILES DRAWN FROM EATING AND ITS RESULTS OCCUR MOST READILY TO THE MIND

results.text: He has grave doubts whether Sir Frederick Leighton's work is really Greek after all, and can discover in it but little of Rocky Ithaca.
